fields.statement: At 5e82132d, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(search|describe-golden)$' passes: search.txtar records nodes and gets disk, store, cache in ranked order; --kind narrows; --limit 1 prints a next_cursor whose page holds store and cache; a bad cursor exits 2; a retired node is not found; a node set in an unlanded change set is found by its new text under what-if and not under as-is; search --json and api call search cmp equal; describe-golden.txtar includes search. By hand with a scratch build, --view as-is and to-be miss the new text and find the old, while what-if finds the new. SchemaVersion went from 1 to 2 with an nodes_fts table, and an index downgraded to user_version 1 with nodes_fts dropped was rebuilt to version 2 on the next search. make check exits 0.
